response.rationale: The vignette explicitly states the patient was referred for surgical management of a "presumed large nonfunctioning pituitary macroadenoma." This directly supports D8 (Pituitary Macroadenoma) and D6 (Nonfunctioning Pituitary Adenoma). However, D8 is more specific by including "Macroadenoma" which is also explicitly mentioned in the vignette. The size of the mass (36 × 41 × 50 mm) further supports the macroadenoma classification. While D6 is also strongly supported, D8 is a more complete and direct match to the initial presumption stated in the vignette.
